title: Refunds on Ridgeline Installation Services Contracts: Tender, Order and Limits
content:
Every refund on a Ridgeline Installation Services contract goes back to the tender of the payment it refunds and references that payment line. A refund never exceeds the payment it references and is never issued in cash for a card or Pro Credit payment. A refund to a Ridgeline Consumer Credit account posts as a return credit on that account, and one to a Ridgeline Pro Credit account as a return credit on that account.

## Status condition

Refunds are issued only on contracts whose status is cancelled, completed or closed, as the contract record shows.

| Contract status | Refund may be issued |
|---|---|
| cancelled, completed, closed | yes |
| measure booked, measured, contracted, scheduled, in progress | no |

## One refund per payment, newest first

A payment line is refunded at most once; when a refund is owed across several payments, the most recent payments are refunded first.

**Hypothetical allocation.** A cancelled contract shows a 500.00 bank card payment on 4 March and a 300.00 Ridgeline Consumer Credit payment on 20 March, and a refund of 600.00 is owed.

| Order | Payment refunded | Refund line | Tender |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 20 March, 300.00 | 300.00 | the Ridgeline Consumer Credit account |
| 2 | 4 March, 500.00 | 300.00 | the bank card |

After these lines, neither payment may be refunded again, even though the 4 March payment was refunded only in part.

## Basis questions answered

**May a refund of a bank card payment be handed over in cash?** No. A refund of a card or Pro Credit payment is never issued in cash; it goes back to the tender of the payment.
